subject.title: [Feature]: Show additional information in `openclaw devices list`

question: Should this issue remain the canonical broad device-list metadata UX after the paired-device rename PR, or be narrowed to a specific CLI column/detail-mode change?
rationale: Current main already has metadata in storage, but the requested UX crosses compact CLI output, optional detail mode, default-device explanation, and editable naming/notes that overlap an open narrower PR.

options.title: Coordinate Broad Metadata UX
options.body: Keep this issue open as the broad tracking item and let maintainers define the sanitized client/platform/activity/detail output after the rename slice is resolved.

options.title: Narrow To CLI Columns
options.body: Limit this issue to adding client/platform/activity columns in `openclaw devices list` and track notes, UI, and rename behavior separately.

options.title: Treat Rename As Enough
options.body: Close or narrow the issue once the rename PR lands, accepting that client/platform/activity/detail output is not part of the current product direction.

recommendation.title: Coordinate Broad Metadata UX
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the broad tracking item and let maintainers define the sanitized client/platform/activity/detail output after the rename slice is resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest feature-history signal across device auth, pairing, devices CLI, and prior review context for this item.
